### 中文

**TXT 现在按纯文本打开。** `# 标题`、星号、空格和换行都会按原文显示，预览和导出 HTML/PDF 时也不会把它们当作 Markdown 语法。Markdown 文档仍使用原来的渲染方式。

- 可用打开对话框或拖放打开 `.txt` 文件；新建文档首次保存时也可选择 TXT。
- 新建 TXT 默认保存为 UTF-8。已有 TXT 手动保存和自动保存时保留原 UTF-8、UTF-8 BOM 或 GBK 编码；若两种解码方式均有效，可根据中文片段选择。
- 如果新增字符不能用 GBK 表示，编辑器不会覆盖原件。按 `Ctrl+S` 可另存为 UTF-8 副本。

**Windows x64：** 日常使用下载 [安装版](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.6/markdown-editor-setup-1.1.6.exe)；无需安装可选 [便携版](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.6/markdown-editor-portable-1.1.6.exe)。

### English

**TXT files now open as plain text.** Markdown markers, spacing and line breaks remain literal in the editor, preview and HTML/PDF exports. Markdown documents keep their usual rendering.

- Open or drop a `.txt` file, or choose TXT when saving a new document.
- New TXT files use UTF-8. Manual save and autosave preserve UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM or GBK for existing files. When the bytes are valid in two encodings, choose between the text samples.
- If an edit cannot be represented in GBK, the original is preserved. Press `Ctrl+S` to save a UTF-8 copy.

**Windows x64:** Download the [installer](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.6/markdown-editor-setup-1.1.6.exe) for everyday use, or choose the [portable build](https://github.com/yibanyiban78/markdown-editor/releases/download/v1.1.6/markdown-editor-portable-1.1.6.exe).
